meta.goal: Complete the trust-critical marketplace flows and make business rules configurable before public soft launch.
meta.summary: Dev and UAT Cloud Run environments are live. Email verification is now the only gate for posting/applying; phone verification is optional and the change is deployed to dev (PR #17). Production email delivery is still required before public sign-up. Mutual cancellation is specified as request/consent with no fee; worker quit and poster disputes remain separate. Full UX/error/edge-case requirements are linked from the backlog. Configurable settings backend work remains unmerged on feat/configurable-contract-settings. Other major gaps include server-side privacy enforcement, cancellation workflow, contract timers, evidence/arbitration, billing, admin operations, and uploads. Guides/FAQ are postponed; fixed-price only remains initial scope and range/negotiable contracts are pinned for early post-release.

milestones.name: Reality sync & UAT deploy
milestones.exitCriteria: Dev and UAT Cloud Run environments are live on custom domains, use separate databases, and pass the smoke check; branch promotion policy is documented. Guides and FAQ are intentionally deferred.

milestones.name: UAT round 1
milestones.exitCriteria: Stakeholder feedback collected and triaged; blocking bugs fixed; docs cleanup plan executed.

milestones.name: Deal lifecycle completion
milestones.exitCriteria: Email-only eligibility rules are implemented; mutual cancellation request/consent flow is complete; configurable settings are editable by admins; lifecycle timers, dispute evidence/arbiter resolution, and server-side visibility rules work against documented policy snapshots; minimal admin operations are usable.

milestones.name: Money & media
milestones.exitCriteria: Configurable fee split applied on completion; billing ledger; monthly invoices with sub-1-GEL carry-over; invoice viewer; R2 uploads with EXIF stripping and MIME validation.

milestones.name: Launch hardening
milestones.exitCriteria: Production email provider works for verification and password reset; SMS is not required while phone verification is optional; gig search/filter/pagination; profile editing; reviews; e2e tests; CI smoke gate; Georgian i18n; PWA; error logging.

milestones.name: Public soft launch
milestones.exitCriteria: Go/no-go review passed; launch plan executed.

engineering.task: Align registration, web prompts, shared guards, and API access checks so email verification is mandatory for posting/applying and phone verification is optional; cover all verification/error states.
engineering.notes: Implemented and deployed to dev in PR #17. Email is required for posting/applying; phone remains collected but optional to verify. Includes email-only guard, email OTP only, clear optional-phone copy, server resend cooldown, stable error codes, and return-to-action verification flow. Requirements: docs/specs/feat-email-required-phone-optional.md.

engineering.task: Implement production email delivery for verification OTP and password reset, including delivery failures and resend/expiry handling.
engineering.notes: Email delivery is required before public sign-up. SMS provider/phone verification is optional and is not a launch blocker under the 2026-10-14 product decision.

engineering.task: Replace unilateral contract cancellation with a mutual request/accept/decline/withdraw workflow, including audit history, notifications, UI states, concurrency handling, and lifecycle regression tests.
engineering.notes: Approved product decision 2026-10-14: both parties must agree at any time; no mutual-cancellation fee. Worker quit stays unilateral; poster uses dispute for incomplete work. Requirements: docs/specs/feat-mutual-contract-cancellation.md.
